svg.text: TENDON LAYOUT, PROFILES AND QUANTITIES TO BE ADDED ON COMPLETION OF THE PT DESIGN
TYPICAL TENDON PROFILE - HEIGHTS TO BE FILLED AFTER PT DESIGN
TENDON SYMBOLS (TO BE USED WHEN THE LAYOUT IS ADDED)
1. ALL DIMENSIONS ARE IN MILLIMETRES, LEVELS IN METRES UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE. DO NOT SCALE; FOLLOW THE WRITTEN DIMENSIONS.
2. THIS SHEET IS A TEMPLATE. TENDON PATHS, PROFILES, STRAND COUNTS, JACKING FORCES AND ELONGATIONS WILL BE ADDED AFTER THE PT
DESIGN IS COMPLETE AND APPROVED; NOTHING ON THIS SHEET IS TO BE USED FOR FABRICATION.
3. PT SYSTEM: BONDED / UNBONDED (TO BE CONFIRMED). STRAND: 15.24 mm (0.6") 7-WIRE LOW-RELAXATION, fpu = 1860 MPa, ASTM A416 / SASO
4. STRESSING AT NOT LESS THAN THE SPECIFIED TRANSFER STRENGTH; JACKING FORCE ≤ 0.80 fpu·Aps; ELONGATION TOLERANCE ±7 % (SBC 304-18
§20.3.2 / PTI). STRESSING RECORD PER TENDON TO BE KEPT ON THE TEMPLATE IN DETAIL 3.
5. GRID, COLUMNS, SLAB OUTLINE, BEAMS, OPENINGS AND SUNKEN SLABS ARE SHOWN FOR REFERENCE ONLY, AS READ FROM THE G.A.
A1. TENDON LAYOUT NOT YET DESIGNED: SCHEDULE AND PROFILE LEFT BLANK BY INTENT.
A2. Bottom mesh not specified: T12@200 both ways assumed as bonded reinforcement in PT zones.
A3. Edge U-bars not specified: T12@200 with 1200 mm legs assumed at PT anchorage edges.
A4. Opening trimmers not specified: 2T16 T&B each side + 2T12 diagonals at corners assumed.
SBC 304-18 AS STATED ON THE STRUCTURAL DRAWINGS. DEVELOPMENT, ANCHORAGE AND LAP LENGTHS PER SBC 304-18 CHAPTER 25 (ACI 318-14
